titulo: A2 review and mock test: Reading and listening (A2 format, original)

aula.objetivo: Review all of A2 on one map, practice reading, listening, writing and speaking in the format of A2 exams, fix the most common mistakes, and take an original practice test.

blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: look at the sentences in the table. STEP 2: in sentences 1 and 3, what comes first: the person (dative) or the thing (accusative)? STEP 3: in sentence 2, «es» is accusative and «dem Kind» is dative. Which comes first? And in sentence 4, where is «es» in relation to «ihm»? Is it like English "it to him"? STEP 4: in sentence 5, the order is "when?", "how?", "where to?". Compare it with the English order "to Berlin by train tomorrow". STEP 5: in sentence 6, did «nicht» end up near the start of the final part, or at the very end? What comes after it? Check your answers in the next blocks.

tabela.frase: 1. Ich gebe dem Kind das Buch.
5. Ich fahre morgen mit dem Zug nach Berlin.
6. Ich habe das Buch nicht gelesen.
